adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` which queries `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb). The migration creating `embeddable_hosts` (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb) does not add any index on `host`, so this lookup will require a scan of the table. Additionally, because the query wraps the column in `lower(host)`, even adding a plain index on `host` would not be used by many DBs without a functional index. This lookup is invoked on embed requests (`EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` now calls `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?`) and in `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?`, so it is on hot paths.
